sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include insulin aspart as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale General holds 175 syringes of insulin aspart 3 mL with 15 days of supply at 11.7 syringes per day.
Corvale Lakeside holds 19 syringes of insulin aspart 3 mL with 5.3 days of supply at 3.6 syringes per day.
The top-ranked option is to transfer 11 syringes of 3 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside.
After the transfer Corvale General would retain 14 days of supply and Corvale Lakeside would reach 8 days of supply.
The transfer requires a pharmacy director transfer request.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
